title: Von-Taube-Weg, Gauting
description:
Room Description

Welcome to this bright and comfortable private room located on Von-Taube-Weg in Gauting, one of the most desirable residential areas in the southwest of Munich. The room offers approximately 9 m2 of thoughtfully furnished living space and is ideal for students, interns, young professionals, and commuters looking for a peaceful yet well-connected home.

The room is equipped with a comfortable bed, a spacious wardrobe, and a practical desk, providing the perfect setup for both relaxation and productivity. The apartment itself spans approximately 90 m2 and is shared with two friendly housemates, creating a welcoming and international living atmosphere. High-speed WiFi and central heating are included.

Common Areas

Residents have access to:

• A well-maintained bathroom
• A separate toilet
• A fully equipped kitchen with all essential appliances
• A washing machine for shared use

Location & Transport

The apartment enjoys an excellent location in Gauting, offering a quiet residential setting with convenient access to Munich and the surrounding region.

Nearby public transport options include:

• Gauting S-Bahn Station (S6) – approx. 12–15 minutes walking distance
• Bus stops with connections to the S-Bahn station and neighboring districts – approx. 3–5 minutes walking distance

Travel times by public transport:

• Munich Central Station (Hauptbahnhof) – approx. 25 minutes via S6
• Marienplatz – approx. 30 minutes
• Starnberg – approx. 10 minutes
• Planegg – approx. 5 minutes
• LMU & TUM city campuses – approx. 35–40 minutes
• Munich Airport – approx. 60 minutes

Neighborhood

Gauting is known for its green surroundings, high quality of life, and excellent infrastructure. Within walking distance you will find:

• Gauting town center with cafés, bakeries, restaurants, and supermarkets
• Several parks and walking trails
• Local sports and fitness facilities
• Pharmacies, banks, and everyday services
• Beautiful forest and nature areas ideal for jogging, cycling, and outdoor activities

The nearby Würm River and surrounding green spaces provide a unique balance between nature and urban accessibility, making Gauting particularly popular among professionals working in Munich who appreciate a quieter living environment.
